data.title: Building Words with Prefixes and Suffixes

targets.hint: This action means to watch a video clip once more.
targets.definition: To show a recorded video clip one more time
targets.sentenceContext: The referee watched the video ___ to check the goal.

targets.hint: This is an artist who creates images on canvas.
targets.definition: An artist who produces images on canvas
targets.sentenceContext: The famous ___ finished a portrait of the king.

targets.hint: This describes someone who is always ready to lend a hand.
targets.definition: Giving aid or useful service to someone
targets.sentenceContext: The librarian was very ___ when finding our books.

targets.hint: This describes someone who is rude and treats others meanly.
targets.definition: Lacking warmth or behaving badly toward others
targets.sentenceContext: It was ___ to tease the boy about his new shoes.
